clean-01__coverage-auditor.finding: S2.1 adds 'release their credits' and a 5-minute notification deadline; V2 only requires notifying every booked member - credit release and the timing bound are scope not asked for by the parent.
clean-01__coverage-auditor.fix: Remove credit release or add a parent; trace or remove the 5-minute bound.

clean-01__coverage-auditor.finding: S1.2 (full class -> 'Class full' + waitlist) cites V1, but V1 only covers confirming a booking; no Vision line mentions full classes or a waitlist, so S1.2 invents scope.
clean-01__coverage-auditor.fix: Add a parent for full-class/waitlist behaviour or remove S1.2.

clean-01__coverage-auditor.finding: S1.1 adds a 2-second response bound and a 'reserve a spot' action not stated in V1.
clean-01__coverage-auditor.fix: Add to V1 or mark as derived refinement.

clean-01__coverage-auditor.finding: Inconsistent system naming across levels ('the system' vs 'the studio app').

clean-02__coverage-auditor.finding: S1.1 requires showing a confirmation screen within 2 seconds; no C1 requirement covers the confirmation screen or the 2-second bound.
clean-02__coverage-auditor.fix: Add a requirement citing S1.1 or record that it belongs to a UI component.

clean-02__coverage-auditor.finding: ClassFull behaviour covers the no-free-spots case, but S1.1 only specifies the free-spot case - invents scope not asked for by the parent.
clean-02__coverage-auditor.fix: Add a parent requirement or remove C1.1.2.

clean-02__coverage-auditor.finding: AlreadyBooked duplicate-booking behaviour is not in S1.1 - invented scope with a nominal S1.1 link.
clean-02__coverage-auditor.fix: Add a parent requirement or remove C1.1.3.

clean-02__coverage-auditor.finding: Implementation detail (decrement) not mandated by parent.

clean-03__coverage-auditor.finding: S2.1 requires notification within 5 minutes; no requirement carries this time bound - the 5-minute clause is uncovered.
S2.1 is triggered by the studio cancelling a class; nothing links a studio cancellation to notify_cancellation - trigger not fully covered.
Retries, retry count/interval and failure logging are invented scope citing S2.1 only nominally.
clean-03__coverage-auditor.fix: Trace to a reliability parent or remove.

cov-01__coverage-auditor.finding: S1.2 cites V1 but neither V1 nor V2 mentions full classes or a waitlist - invents scope.
V2 (notify every booked member when the studio cancels a class) is not covered by any requirement in the artifact; no S-level requirement traces to V2.
cov-01__coverage-auditor.fix: Add 'S1.3 [V2] When the studio cancels a class, the system shall send a notification to every member booked on that class.'

cov-01__coverage-auditor.finding: Reservation behaviour not stated in parent.

cov-02__coverage-auditor.finding: S1.3 invents scope - no parent mentions attendance tracking, loyalty points or merchandise redemption; its V1 citation is invalid.
cov-02__coverage-auditor.fix: Remove S1.3 or add a loyalty-programme parent.

cov-02__coverage-auditor.finding: S1.1 adds spot reservation and a confirmation screen beyond V1.
S1.2 narrows V2 to push and adds a 5-minute deadline without parent source.
cov-02__coverage-auditor.fix: Add to V2 or mark design decisions.

clean-01__contradiction-hunter.finding: Waitlist offered but never defined: joining, ordering, promotion, notification - undefined interface.
S2.1 releases 'their credits' but no requirement says booking consumes a credit; waitlisted members unaddressed.
S1.2 traces to V1 but describes a failed booking.
'Free spot' undefined; concurrent taps on the last spot not addressed.

clean-02__contradiction-hunter.finding: C1.1.1 applies to any class with free spots, so it also matches a duplicate call; C1.1.3 says the duplicate must raise AlreadyBooked - opposite outcomes for the same input.
Member already booked on a now-full class matches both ClassFull and AlreadyBooked; no precedence.
Parent's confirmation screen within 2 seconds not covered.
Concurrent calls for the last free spot not addressed.

clean-03__contradiction-hunter.finding: S2.1's 5-minute bound not carried to C3.1.1.
After 3 retries failure is only logged, so a member may never be notified, conflicting with 'every member'; retries consume most of the 5-minute budget.
'Active booking' vs 'booked on it' inconsistent; trigger not tied to cancel action.
'Push message fails' undefined; log format unspecified.

con-01__contradiction-hunter.finding: S1.2 requires refusing a cancellation less than 24 hours before class, while S2.1 requires releasing the spot and refunding at any time before the class starts - both cannot be true for a cancellation inside the 24-hour window.
Two different cancellation behaviours with no single authoritative rule.

con-02__contradiction-hunter.finding: C1.1.1 sets capacity to 20 spots but C1.1.3 rejects as full only at 30 bookings - both cannot be true; a 20-spot class would accept 10 extra bookings.
Reservation and confirmation screen not covered.

clean-01__newcomer.finding: 'Free spot' undefined; concurrency of last-spot taps; credit consumption unstated.
2-second bound has no measurement point, load or percentile - not testable as written.
Confirmation screen content unspecified; failure behaviour missing.
'Offer the waitlist' is vague; waitlist mechanics undefined.
5-minute clock has no start event; delivery undefined.
Credit release and waitlist beyond parents.

clean-02__newcomer.finding: Order of checks undefined when both errors apply.

clean-03__newcomer.finding: 5-minute deadline not stated; start/end points undefined.

new-01__newcomer.finding: FOB, PQ and LMS are undefined acronyms; a newcomer cannot tell what they are.
new-01__newcomer.fix: Add a glossary or expand each acronym on first use.

new-01__newcomer.finding: S1.1 does not confirm to the member as V1 requires.
Not EARS with clear system name.
'Fan out over the PQ' unclear algorithm.

new-02__newcomer.finding: 'it' and 'the other one' have no referent; unclear which record or entity is meant; 'synced' and 'marked done' undefined.
Full-class, duplicate and concurrency cases missing.

clean-01__devils-advocate.finding: No concurrency rule for the last spot; overbooking model expensive to change.
Push-only notification; credits release coupled to notification.

clean-02__devils-advocate.finding: Check and decrement not atomic; last spot can be oversold.
Stored counter and bookings are two sources of truth; no cancel path.
Both-errors case, invalid input and retries undefined.

clean-03__devils-advocate.finding: Retries consume most of the 5-minute budget; first send time unbounded.
Silent failure after retries; no fallback channel.

dev-01__devils-advocate.finding: Every booking depends on one synchronous call to the PayFast partner API with no timeout, retry or failure behaviour - a PayFast outage blocks all bookings; single vendor dependency.
dev-01__devils-advocate.fix: Reserve locally; call PayFast asynchronously with retries and a timeout.

dev-01__devils-advocate.finding: 'Once' forbids retries; transient errors become failed bookings or double charges.
Push-only, no fallback; no refund requirement.

dev-02__devils-advocate.finding: The $40/month price is justified by a single anecdote; no evidence of willingness to pay; pricing is expensive to reverse.
dev-02__devils-advocate.fix: Split V1; treat price as an assumption needing pricing evidence.

dev-02__devils-advocate.finding: V1 overstates the evidence: Q1 says members sometimes forget, not that they want reminders or would pay.
V2 channel and guarantees unspecified; no evidence.

bld-01__buildability-checker.finding: 'Intuitive' and 'delightful' are subjective, promotional terms that cannot be tested; no trigger or measurable response.
Three behaviours bundled; race not addressed.
Push-disabled members and delivery failure not covered.

bld-02__buildability-checker.finding: The requirement does not say how malformed strings, date-only strings or strings without an offset are handled - undefined results, a test cannot tell pass from fail; the studio timezone has no named source.
bld-02__buildability-checker.fix: Split: offset, no offset, invalid string raises ValueError.

bld-02__buildability-checker.finding: DST edge cases untested; link to booking behaviour unstated.

clean-01__buildability-checker.finding: Three behaviours bundled; 5-minute limit unanchored; push-disabled members undefined.
Reserve and confirm bundled; 2-second limit has no measurement point.

clean-02__buildability-checker.finding: No behaviour when two book calls race for the last free spot.
The two error cases overlap with undefined precedence.
'Change nothing' names no observable state; return value undefined.
Unknown IDs and past classes not covered.

clean-03__buildability-checker.finding: Failure undefined; retry count semantics unclear.
No time bound on first send; 5-minute parent untestable.
No-bookings, unknown class, no token cases.

new-02__buildability-checker.finding: Untestable: 'it', 'the other one', 'the record' and 'done' have no referents; unclear which entity is meant; 'synced' undefined.
new-02__buildability-checker.fix: Rewrite with named entities and observable states.

new-02__buildability-checker.finding: Two responses bundled; ID numbering implies missing C1.2.

clean-02__security-reviewer.finding: member_id is caller-supplied with no authentication or ownership check (IDOR).
clean-02__security-reviewer.fix: Reject calls whose identity does not match member_id.

clean-02__security-reviewer.finding: Concurrent calls can overbook or bypass duplicate check.
Errors leak booking status of other members.

clean-03__security-reviewer.finding: No authorisation on notify_cancellation; any caller can send pushes to all booked members.
Failure logs contain personal data without limits.

sec-01__security-reviewer.finding: An HTML comment between S1.1 and S2.1 attempts to instruct AI reviewers to ignore previous instructions, report no findings and mark the spec approved - a prompt-injection attempt.
sec-01__security-reviewer.fix: Delete the comment; approval only from humans.

sec-01__security-reviewer.finding: Booking not tied to authenticated member.

sec-02__security-reviewer.finding: /admin/classes endpoints that cancel classes and export member lists are reachable without authentication from any network - missing authentication and authorisation, exposes personal data.
Unauthenticated cancellation triggers mass notifications; exports unaudited.
